drop: Drop a PowerPoint presentation, slideshow, or template here to convert it to PDF
privacy: Your document stays in this browser. No uploads or remote content.
invalid: Choose a readable PPTX, PPTM, POTX, POTM, PPSX, or PPSM file. It may be damaged or use an unsupported feature.
failed: The PDF could not be created. No incomplete file is available for download.
unsupported: This document contains missing or unsupported content. No incomplete PDF was created.
resource: The browser could not allocate enough resources to render this document. Close other tabs or try another device.
engineUnavailable: The conversion engine could not start. Reload the page or try a current browser.
fidelity: Each slide is rendered as an image page at 150 DPI, using the presentation’s slide size and orientation. Slides stay in their original order.
limitations: Text is not selectable and OCR is not added. Animations, transitions, audio and video playback, speaker notes, comments, interactive links, macros, and digital signatures are not preserved or verified.
protected: Password-protected PowerPoint files are not supported. Save an unencrypted copy in your Office application and try again.
layoutNotice: All slides, including hidden slides, are exported. Fonts and effects may differ from PowerPoint. Check text, images, charts, and objects in the preview before downloading.
